findings.description: Tomasa Tassara was born about 1864 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, according to the 1895 national census, which lists her as a married woman in the rural first district (Cuartel 01) of Mercedes, Buenos Aires; the year is computed from her census age.
supporting_sources: Argentina, National Census, 1895 — household entry for Tomasa Tassara, Cuartel 01 (Población rural), Mercedes, Buenos Aires, born 1864
